steps.domain_action: Initialize random seed in the 683-dimensional Zauner sector
Compute correlation vector via cyclic shift and element-wise multiplication
Apply FFT to correlation vector to generate the ambiguity function A
Branch the ambiguity function into the residual vector r and the norm constraint nu
Apply the adjoint Jacobian action J^T to the residual vector r
Apply the adjoint Jacobian action J^T to the norm residual nu
Reconstitute the gradient vector in the Zauner sector from both branches
Verify the gradient against the analytic Wirtinger identity
Record the current iteration state and objective value to the JSON manifest
Execute the Conjugate Gradient solve for the damped normal equations
Update the fiducial vector psi using the calculated descent direction
Evaluate the new state against the convergence criteria
Confirm the residual is below the deep-vanish floor
Detect objective plateau or lack of progress
Reconcile the branch evaluation to determine the next iteration step
Perform self-referential norm stabilization to maintain unit length
Fix the final converged fiducial vector to the permanent coordinate witness
Close the campaign upon reaching the terminal SIC existence boundary
